# BigCommerce

> > BigCommerce is an enterprise ecommerce platform enabling B2B and multi-channel commerce with integrated tools for checkout optimization, ERP/PIM connectivity, and merchandising.

BigCommerce provides a comprehensive commerce platform featuring B2B Edition for wholesale operations, Feedonomics for product feed management, and enterprise-grade solutions for multi-channel selling. The platform supports businesses scaling their online presence with advanced checkout, catalog management, and third-party integrations.

## Key Topics

- B2B Edition
- Feedonomics
- Multi-channel selling
- Checkout optimization
- Enterprise commerce
- ERP integration
- PIM integration
- Ecommerce platform
- B2B commerce
- Platform overview
